frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We did it! We've replaced all four amps, and stopped the Grand Composer from his evil plan of silencing the universe!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Groovy!!! But... What's stopping him from doing all of this again?

frames.heading: Space
frames.body: The planet starts to rumble, space junk shooting through the atmosphere.

frames.heading: Space
frames.body: A shrieking cry fills the air, the planet is being sucked into a vortex!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: The Grand Composer is trying to stop us!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Player, this is it. Our final song will break his hold over the galaxy.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Let's give it everything we've got!
